summary.text: Linda Pierce is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Donna Veach.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a longtime educator with 20 years as an English teacher.

paragraphs.text: Pierce earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Mexico and a graduate degree from the University of Massachusetts in 2001, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as director.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she spent 20 years as an English teacher and is an avid hiker and outdoor enthusiast.
Pierce said in her survey that she is running to represent Berlin and Southington and that her campaign centers on affordability, healthcare access, public education and protecting the environment.
She said she wants to address gaps in programs such as HUSKY and Covered Connecticut so that working families do not face a benefits cliff.
